description: Defines the interface for a DatagramClientSocket class used for UDP socket communication in the Chromium project, including connection methods, network binding, socket tagging, and configuration options.

classes.name: DatagramClientSocket
classes.description: Interface for a UDP datagram socket client, supporting connection, network binding, socket tagging, and configuration.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Initialize socket as a client to a server at the specified address.

methods.name: ConnectUsingNetwork
methods.description: Bind socket to a specific network and connect to the server.

methods.name: ConnectUsingDefaultNetwork
methods.description: Connect to server using the default network.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously connect to a server at the specified address.

methods.name: ConnectUsingNetworkAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously connect to a server on a specific network.

methods.name: ConnectUsingDefaultNetworkAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously connect to a server using the default network.

methods.name: GetBoundNetwork
methods.description: Retrieve the network handle the socket is bound to.

methods.name: ApplySocketTag
methods.description: Apply a socket tag for network traffic identification.

methods.name: EnableRecvOptimization
methods.description: Enable experimental receive optimization (no-op by default).

methods.name: SetMulticastInterface
methods.description: Set network interface for multicast traffic.

methods.name: SetIOSNetworkServiceType
methods.description: Set iOS network service type for socket options (no-op by default).
